race.comment: EUPHORIC MISS (3) gets the nod off a close Gulargambone fourth where she was favourite and was on or near heels around the 300m, so there was enough in the run. She has the 3kg claim and the best recent profile in a modest maiden. IT'S A POWER (7) is the clear danger after resuming with a second at Winton, beaten a length and a half, and her record at around this trip keeps her firmly in the mix. WHISKEY DRY (2) has not broken through from 12 starts, but six placings and four minors from six tries around 1000m make him a reliable place chance if he offsets the wide draw. HIGHWIRE FLYER (4) was plain first-up at Hawkesbury, yet the drop from provincial grade gives her some scope to improve into a minor role. Look for a big run for the new stable. Something for the Multiples: SNAPPEN (8)
